Good! I can see the issue clearly. Both pods are crashing with the same error: `panic: runtime error: index out of range [3] with length 3`. The crash is happening when compiling a rule called `BF-2026-STACKED` with `tiers=3` and `stacking=true`. The error is occurring in the `TierTable.Lookup` function when it tries to access index 3 on an array of length 3 (which would be out of bounds for 0-indexed arrays).

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to understand CrashLoopBackOff and what causes application crashes in pods.
